method: Exhaustively enumerate five-dataset holdouts from non-exposed units, preserving {013,015} atomically and requiring all four families. Rank valid candidates lexicographically by: number of distinct calendar models; shapes presence states; feed_info presence states; distinct GTFS table names; corpus-derived size bands represented; route-count range; stop-count range; trip-count range; input ZIP-size range. Prefer larger coverage/ranges in that order; break any remaining tie by sorted dataset_id tuple. Family strata are descriptive constraints, not lineage. No validator outcomes, findings, statuses, or result-derived quality were used.
selection_basis: Candidate C is the unique winner under the documented exhaustive lexicographic input-only comparison. HOLDOUT 006, 008, 013, 015, 017 covers all three calendar models, both shapes and feed_info states, 15 distinct GTFS tables, and all three size bands. Known Pilot Audit 01 exposure remains DEVELOPMENT. The pair 013/015 is atomic. Provenance is MEDIUM, with NAP resource IDs, source URLs, and capture dates unknown.
